Yahoo Mail: Search, Organize, Conquer
Handed to the team · Discount request in a sales thread plus a roadmap question I cannot answer from

Hi, and thanks for the kind words.

On the pricing, our prices are as listed on the site, so I can't put a discount on a second unit myself. I've passed it to Georges and he's picking it up today, so if there's anything to be done on a second-unit price he'll come back to you directly in this thread.

On a bigger unit, I don't want to guess at something that isn't announced. The best value in the current lineup is the Magic Miner 40T at 40 TH/s for $799 and the Harlo B30 at around 30 TH/s for $899. Georges is the one who knows what's coming next, so I've asked him to answer that part for you too.

Best,
Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
